title: NYC Daily Digest
text:
☀️ Good morning, Matthew! It's Wednesday, November 4, 2026.

🌤️ Weather
Unusually warm for November. Expect some morning fog that burns off to sunshine. It's in the low 60s now, with a high of about 72°F and a low near 62°F tonight. Chance of rain today is close to zero. Heavy rain is coming Thursday night into Friday, possibly 1 to 2 inches.
👕 What to wear: a light layer or just a T-shirt. Leave the umbrella home today, but have it ready for Friday.

🗞️ Headlines
• Democrats take both chambers: the AP called the House for Democrats early this morning, and Democrats also won the Senate, giving them full control of Congress. Hakeem Jeffries is set to become Speaker.
• Hochul wins a second full term: she beat Nassau County Executive Bruce Blakeman by about 20 points, and he has conceded. Adrienne Adams becomes NY's first Black woman lieutenant governor, and AG Letitia James was also re-elected.
• More Democratic wins: Democrats picked up governor's races including Texas (Gina Hinojosa) and Georgia (Keisha Lance Bottoms). In Maine, Troy Jackson unseated Sen. Susan Collins.
• Iran: the WSJ reports the US struck Iran's Qeshm Island overnight, the latest in a series of secret strikes. Trump says Iran wants a settlement.
• Ukraine: a new Russian strike killed at least 33 people, and attacks on power stations in the Kyiv and Zhytomyr regions continue.

🚇 Getting around
No major weekday subway disruptions reported this morning. Weekend work at Myrtle Av continues through Nov 23. Check the MTA app before you head out.

🎉 NYC today
• Punch Brothers play Carnegie Hall at 8 PM, and Ólafur Arnalds is at The Town Hall at 8 PM.
• Coming up: the New York Comedy Festival runs Friday, Nov 6 through Sunday, Nov 15.

💡 Nugget
Clocks went back Sunday, so the sun now sets around 4:50 PM. With 70s today and a soaker on Friday, a lunchtime walk outside today is a good idea.
